title: I Forced AI to Build a Custom Operating System (It Actually Worked)
description:
I challenged Claude Opus 5.5 to build a fully functional, bootable operating system from scratch using only 2 prompts. No Linux templates, no pre-built kernels—just raw C and Assembly code written entirely by AI.

Watch as we compile the .ISO file, bypass the Apple Silicon VirtualBox limits using QEMU, and successfully boot "AuroraOS"! It even has a working dock, a file manager, and a text-based web browser that actually connects to the internet. Are AI coding agents getting too powerful?

👇 What should I force Claude to build next? Let me know in the comments!

⏳ CHAPTERS:
0:00 - The Impossible AI Challenge
1:18 - What goes into building a real OS?
2:43 - Claude writes 6,000+ lines of code
3:06 - The VirtualBox Crash & Fix (QEMU)
3:30 - Booting AuroraOS for the first time
5:18 - Pushing it further: Adding a Web Browser
7:18 - Final Verdict: Can Claude replace developers?

💻 TOOLS USED IN THIS VIDEO:
• Claude Opus 5.5 (AI Coding)

• C & Assembly Language
